title: Test slugify (JS)
skill: List the cases the tests must cover

good: Create test/slugify.test.js for slugify() in src/slugify.js. Use node:test and node:assert/strict, and import { slugify } from "../src/slugify.js". One test per rule, each with assert.equal: "Hello World" -> "hello-world"; "Crème Brûlée" -> "creme-brulee"; "a  &  b" -> "a-b"; "  ¡Hola!  " -> "hola"; "a".repeat(50) -> "a".repeat(40); "a".repeat(39) + " bcd" -> "a".repeat(39) (the cut at 40 ends on a hyphen, which is dropped). Do not change src/slugify.js or test/smoke.test.js. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
